paper.title: A minimax and asymptotically optimal algorithm for stochastic bandits

settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic K-armed bandit with one-dimensional canonical exponential family arms, bounded means and bounded variance (family F)
unmapped: Variance of the exponential family bounded uniformly by V on I (Pinsker-like inequality kl >= (mu-mu')^2/(2V))
Means restricted to [mu^-, mu^+] strictly inside the family's mean range
settings.definition_quote: Each arm is assumed to be a probability distribution of some canonical one-dimensional exponential family $\nu_{\theta}$ indexed by $\theta\in\Theta$. ... we suppose that each arm $\nu_\theta$ satisfies $\mu=b'(\theta)\in [\mu-,\mu+]\subset I$ ... there exists $V>0$ such that $\sup_{\mu\in I} b''( {b'}^{-1}(\mu))\leq V<+\infty$.

symbols.V: uniform upper bound on the variance of the exponential family
symbols.mu_plus: upper end of the interval containing all arm means
symbols.mu_minus: lower end of the interval containing all arm means

source.label: th:minimax_bound
source.quote: For any family $\mathcal{F}$ satisfying the assumptions detailed in Section~\ref{sec:settings}, and for any bandit model $\nu\in\mathcal{F}$, the expected regret of the kl-UC$\Bpp$ algorithm is upper-bounded as R_T\leq 76 \sqrt{ V K T}+(\mu^+-\mu^-)K\,.

results.notes: Regret defined as E[sum (mu* - mu_{A_t})], i.e. pseudo-regret. Paper notes the bound also applies to [0,1]-valued bandits with V=1/4.

symbols.delta_a: free analysis parameter delta in the theorem
symbols.V: uniform upper bound on the variance of the exponential family

source.label: th:asymptotic_bound
source.quote: For any bandit model $\nu\in\mathcal{F}$, for any suboptimal arm $a$ and any $\delta$ such that $\sqrt{22 V K / T}\leq \delta\leq(\mustar-\mu_a)/3$, \E[N_a(T)]\leq \frac{\log(T)}{\kl(\mu_a+\delta,\mu^\star-\delta)}+O\left(\frac{\loglog(T)}{\delta^2}\right)

results.notes: Bound on expected number of pulls of a suboptimal arm; leading term has constant 1, only the second-order term is O(.). Explicit bound in proof: log(T)/kl + log((1/K)(1+log^2(T/K)))/kl + (16e^2+2)*2VK/delta^2 + 1.

tuning: delta of order 1/sqrt(loglog T) in the analysis

source.label: th:asymptotic_bound
source.quote: which implies the asymptotic optimality (see the end of the proof in Section~\ref{sec:proof:asymptotic} for an explicit bound).

results.notes: Asymptotic optimality (matching Lai-Robbins) is claimed as an implication of Theorem 2 by choosing delta ~ 1/sqrt(loglog T); written here as limsup form. kl is the family's divergence (Bernoulli kl for Bernoulli arms).

cited_results.setting_description: Stochastic K-armed bandit, exponential family arms, uniformly efficient strategies; lower bound on expected pulls of suboptimal arm
Minimax lower bound over family F of exponential-family bandit problems (adaptation of Theorem A.2)
